sources.name: Lumen Project
sources.category: rare immersive music / deep listening / sound-light-space experiences
sources.editorial_instructions: USER'S FAVORITE STOCKHOLM MUSIC EVENT — top preference signal. Check EVERY Saturday and Sunday even if the prior week had no events; scan the upcoming calendar beyond the normal 14-day window for advance ticket opportunities (e.g. 2–6 months), and mark dates outside the issue range as future leads rather than presenting them as within the current 14 days. Prioritize suitable upcoming Lumen shows when confirmed, including as potential Top 3 after fresh official source, image, date and ticket verification. Do not invent events or assume quarterly means regular dates. Keep coverage of other organizers broad; no filler when Lumen has no event.

source_diversity_policy.purpose: Prevent repeated overreliance on two or three organizer sites.
source_diversity_policy.saturday_and_sunday: Independently scan broad sets of official organizers, art, participatory, performance, tech, music, cinema and small independent venues in both Swedish and English.
source_diversity_policy.scanning_accountability: Prepare a concise source coverage log listing domains visited, events found, gaps, and why a narrow final edition is justified. Do not falsify visited evidence or add weak filler.
source_diversity_policy.editorial_selection: Select events by personal relevance and freshness; reviewed sites need not be featured. No requirement to include events from any particular organizer.
source_diversity_policy.personal_priority: Lumen Project is the user's favorite Stockholm music experience: monitor its rare announcements and future dates without requiring frequent events.
source_diversity_policy.aggregators: Use Visit Stockholm, Nattljud, Resident Advisor, Evenemang Stockholm, and Slakthusguiden as discovery indexes; direct organizer pages must independently substantiate each newsletter event.
source_diversity_policy.removed_source: Slakthusen removed as user-requested preferred venue; Fållan added instead.
